name: cost-waterfall-core
title: Run cost core
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Integer micro-unit pricing, cache savings, rollups, and a streaming reducer for one agent run. Example adapters cover a workflow node and a blended cost per 1K tokens.

meta.descriptionEs: Precio en micro-unidades, ahorro de caché, agregados y un reducer de streaming para una corrida. Los adaptadores de ejemplo cubren un nodo de flujo y el costo mezclado por 1K tokens.

examples.title: Expediente de ejemplo
examples.description: Precios ilustrativos, no una tarjeta de proveedor.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Costo vacío, nombre largo y mezcla por 1K.

meta.usage:
rollupRun(run, pricing)
applyRunEvent(run, event)
blendedCostPer1k(pricing, model, mix)

api.name: PricingTable
api.description: Micro-units per 1_000_000 tokens for input, output, cache read, and cache write.

api.name: ownCost / cacheSavings
api.description: Explicit costMicro wins. Savings are cache reads priced below input.

api.name: rollupRun
api.description: Parents roll up children. mostExpensiveId is the greatest own cost above zero.

api.name: applyRunEvent
api.description: step.started, step.progress, step.completed, step.failed, run.completed. Duplicates and older stamps are ignored.

api.name: runFromWorkflowNodes
api.description: Example adapter. replay is stored on payload and is not priced.

api.name: blendedCostPer1k
api.description: Example adapter. Micro-units per 1_000 tokens of the mix.

docs: Clean-room. Affect UI Cost Waterfall is Pro and was not fetched. Money is an integer micro-unit (1_000_000 = 1.00). Install this item alone when a host only needs the math. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite csv.
